primary_false_pass: Treating a local key-held result as product/display/system behavior.
primary_false_fail: Discarding a real local boundary after a helper or browser update without rerunning controls.
guardrail: Keep local wording tied to helper, browser, trace placement, and statistic.
redundant_check: Small trigger-control rerun after helper/browser/statistic changes.
interpretation_rule: If the trigger changes, reopen only that trigger; otherwise stop local-semantics work.

primary_false_pass: CI wait removal appears safe because q50 is stable while failures, first-key tails, or resources regress.
primary_false_fail: A noisy CI lane rejects a stable local decision because branch order or runner phase was uncontrolled.
guardrail: Require raw retained rows, failures, resources, first-key tails, branch order, and environment metadata.
redundant_check: Same-runner paired/reversed-order rerun plus first-key-only slice.
interpretation_rule: If non-q50 fields disagree, block wait changes and narrow the topology artifact.

primary_false_pass: A predicate passes q50 but moves preview/canvas readiness or late resources into measurement.
primary_false_fail: A valid predicate is rejected because one endpoint group or cache state was not separated.
guardrail: Split by spec, lane, endpoint group, preview/canvas behavior, timeout, and fallback path.
redundant_check: Predicate-only versus fixed-wait rows by endpoint group.
interpretation_rule: If readiness evidence is mixed, keep/narrow waits or use fixed fallback; do not cite q50 alone.

primary_false_pass: A source patch wins timing by changing editor semantics or public data behavior.
primary_false_fail: A safe patch is rejected because aggregate timing did not move in a noisy run.
guardrail: Behavior and compatibility fixtures must pass before source spans and aggregate timing are considered.
redundant_check: Timing-disabled fixture rerun plus marker-only source-span microscope.
interpretation_rule: Behavior failure rejects the patch; source-span failure re-scopes the owner; aggregate-only movement is unexplained.

primary_false_pass: Unjoinable or perturbing sidecar rows are interpreted as mechanism evidence.
primary_false_fail: A useful sidecar is rejected because clock sync, renderer identity, or command identity was under-instrumented.
guardrail: Require key-window IDs, clock sync, renderer/command identity, join coverage, and sidecar-on/off ordering controls.
redundant_check: Synthetic known-key-window calibration plus observer-overhead A/B rows.
interpretation_rule: If join or overhead fails, redesign the sidecar before running runtime or root-counter observers.

primary_false_pass: A runtime checkpoint dose response is named as V8/scheduler state without a joined differentiating field.
primary_false_fail: A real runtime state is missed because sidecar fields are too coarse or observer placement is wrong.
guardrail: Name only fields joined to retained keys that separate fast and slow classes without changing ordering.
redundant_check: Trace-off command sidecar plus runtime-repeat controls.
interpretation_rule: If no runtime field separates classes, keep the runtime result empirical or move to another observer.

primary_false_pass: Latency classes are overfit into frequency, P-core, QoS, cache, or runnable-latency names.
primary_false_fail: A real system mechanism is missed because counter interval, root permissions, or collector overhead is inadequate.
guardrail: Run counters only after sidecar acceptance and compare counter-on/off class ordering.
redundant_check: Root `powermetrics` first, root trace fallback only if counters do not separate classes.
interpretation_rule: If counters fail or perturb ordering, downgrade to empirical CPU-state sensitivity.

primary_false_pass: Fixed-`x` insertion is treated as representative product workload latency.
primary_false_fail: A useful product stratum is rejected because replay assertions or recorded corpus coverage are incomplete.
guardrail: Require per-stratum assertions, source spans, retained rows, and behavior checks.
redundant_check: Synthetic stratum first, recorded workload pilot second.
interpretation_rule: Scope claims by passing stratum; failures do not weaken the fixed-`x` benchmark artifact.

primary_false_pass: Chromium-internal screenshots or paint events are called hardware/display latency.
primary_false_fail: A valid external endpoint is rejected because calibration or observer-overhead controls are missing.
guardrail: Join external endpoint timestamps to retained keys and prove observer-on/off ordering is preserved.
redundant_check: Internal screenshot control plus single-endpoint calibration ladder.
interpretation_rule: If endpoint ordering differs, scope the display claim or redesign the observer.

primary_false_pass: Local q50 movement is treated as a repository or dashboard pass/fail gate.
primary_false_fail: A useful CI artifact is dismissed because external reviewer/dashboard policy is undocumented.
guardrail: Separate artifact production from external policy; require documented threshold/reviewer rule.
redundant_check: CodeVitals/reviewer policy join against archived raw CI artifacts.
interpretation_rule: If policy is unavailable, report q50 as evidence, not pass/fail prediction.
